title: Remittances and Returned Remittances under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement
content:
The employer remits the deducted amounts for each deduction schedule by its due date. Under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement the following terms govern how remittances are accepted, applied and reversed.

**Accepted methods.** A remittance is accepted only by a method listed among the remittance methods allowed for the agreement's tier, as the agreement record's tier shows.

**Application.** Each remittance is applied to the schedule it names, up to that schedule's open amount. The open amount of a schedule, as of today, is the schedule amount less the remittances and write-offs pointing to it, plus the remittance returns pointing to it. A partial remittance leaves the rest of that schedule open, and any amount above the schedule's open amount is applied to the employer's oldest other open schedule, never to program invoices.

**Returns.** When the employer's bank returns an ACH debit of a remittance unpaid, the remittance is reversed by a remittance return pointing to it, the schedule's open amount is reinstated as of its original due date, and an ACH return fee invoice line of the tier's ACH debit return fee is billed. A returned employer-initiated credit or wire is reversed the same way without that fee. A remittance is returned at most once.

**Separation from other money.** Remittances of worker-level deductions never pass through workers' card accounts or reduce program charges.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical)

A schedule of 18400.00 receives a remittance of 18000.00: 400.00 stays open on it. A later remittance naming that schedule for 900.00 settles the 400.00 and the other 500.00 goes to the employer's oldest other open schedule. If the 18000.00 remittance was an ACH debit and the employer's bank returns it, a remittance return of 18000.00 points to it, the schedule is again open by 18000.00 as of its original due date, and the tier's ACH debit return fee is billed as an ACH return fee line. Had it been a wire, the reversal would carry no fee.

| Returned remittance method | Remittance return booked | ACH return fee line billed |
|---|---|---|
| ACH debit authorization | yes | yes |
| employer ACH credit | yes | no |
| wire | yes | no |
